intent: Say in one short line what the page holds or how much of it there is.
typical_uses: A one-line summary under a section's title
The counts of what a list holds, such as "12 invoices · 3 overdue"

dont_use_when.situation: A status or an error about the page, such as a failed request

invariants.text: PageHeaderDescription sets the meta role (12/16) in --muted-foreground, var(--space-1) under the title, across the full width of the text block.

anti_patterns.dont: Write a paragraph into the header
anti_patterns.do_instead: Keep the description to one line and put a longer explanation in the page's own content

good.title: The counts under a list's title

bad.title: A paragraph of instructions in the header
bad.code:
<PageHeaderDescription>
  Connect a repository, a document store or a ticket tracker. Each source is read once an hour,
  and you can trigger a read by hand from its own page. Removing a source keeps what was read.
</PageHeaderDescription>
bad.why: The header is a bar of a drawn height; a paragraph grows it past that height and pushes the page's content down, and it reads as body text set in the header's muted meta role.
